subject.title: feat(gateway): add ticketed read-only MCP App host

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this process-local signed ticket as the supported least-privilege authorization boundary for standalone MCP App views?
rationale: Tests can verify the implementation, but only maintainers can accept the product security model, replay window, restart invalidation, external-origin behavior, and future channel-launch contract.

options.title: Approve the bounded ticket host
options.body: Accept the read-only capability model after focused threat-model and exact-head external-origin review, then land the additive implementation.

options.title: Require boundary changes
options.body: Keep the PR open and request narrower replay, origin, invalidation, or deployment semantics before adopting the host contract.

options.title: Pause standalone hosting
options.body: Close or defer the PR if standalone and future channel browser launches are not an approved core direction.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded ticket host
recommendation.body: Accept the read-only capability model after focused threat-model and exact-head external-origin review, then land the additive implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member currently owning the paired proposal, implementation, security rationale, and conformance fixture.
